tagline.zh: 极光渐变:多层低亮度 oklch 光斑 radial-gradient 叠在一层 conic 底色上,整层 blur+saturate 后缓慢平移——大面积、可动画、几乎零成本的『氛围光』。
tagline.en: Aurora gradient: stacked low-luminance oklch radial-gradient blobs over a conic base, blurred and saturated as one layer, then drifted slowly — an ambient glow at near-zero cost.

origin.zh: 社区配方,出处 CodeFronts《Animated Mesh / Aurora Gradient Background》(MIT 许可,调研 06§四14 一手抓取),结构原型来自 MDN《Using CSS gradients》的多层 radial-gradient 叠加;非任何设计系统的官方材质。
origin.en: A community recipe from CodeFronts' 'Animated Mesh / Aurora Gradient Background' (MIT licensed; research 06 §14, primary fetch), structurally prototyped on MDN's stacked radial-gradients in 'Using CSS gradients'; not an official material of any design system.

effect.zh: 光斑数量。默认 4 = CodeFronts 配方的 4 个 radial-gradient 光斑 + 1 层 conic 底色(调研 06§14);减到 3 是成本/氛围的折中。JS 型参数,demo 切 data-spots 隐藏第 4 个光斑。
effect.en: Blob count. Default 4 = CodeFronts' four radial-gradient blobs plus one conic base layer (research 06 §14); 3 is the cost/ambience trade-off. JS-type param: the demo toggles data-spots to hide the fourth blob.

effect.zh: 整层模糊半径,把硬边光斑融成极光。默认 42px 为 CodeFronts 配方原文 filter: blur(42px)(调研 06§14)。
effect.en: Whole-layer blur radius that melts hard-edged blobs into aurora. Default 42px is the CodeFronts recipe's literal filter: blur(42px) (research 06 §14).

effect.zh: 整层饱和度提升,blur 会洗掉颜色,用 saturate 补回来。默认 115% 对应 CodeFronts 配方 filter: saturate(1.15)(调研 06§14)。
effect.en: Whole-layer saturation boost — blur washes color out, saturate brings it back. Default 115% matches the CodeFronts recipe's filter: saturate(1.15) (research 06 §14).

effect.zh: 整层漂移动画一轮时长(平移/旋转/缩放,ease-in-out alternate),0 = 静止。CodeFronts 配方原文为 60s 慢漂(调研 06§14);默认 18s 是本批任务规格给定的演示档,并非调研记载值——做生产氛围背景时建议改回 60s 级别。
effect.en: One cycle of the whole-layer drift animation (translate/rotate/scale, ease-in-out alternate); 0 = static. The CodeFronts recipe itself uses 60s (research 06 §14); the default 18s is the demo scale set by this batch's spec, not a research-recorded value — for production ambience prefer 60s-class durations.

effect.zh: 光斑 A 的横向位置(at x% y%)。默认 20% 为 CodeFronts 首光斑记载值(38% 42% at 20% 25%,调研 06§14);纵向固定 25%。改位置即 MDN 所说『mesh 编辑器』玩法。
effect.en: Horizontal position of blob A (at x% y%). Default 20% is CodeFronts' recorded first-blob value (38% 42% at 20% 25%, research 06 §14); the vertical axis stays at 25%. Moving blobs is the 'mesh editor' play MDN describes.

effect.zh: 光斑 B 的横向位置(at x% y%,纵向固定 30%)。CodeFronts 只逐值记载了首光斑位置,70% 为演示取值(社区常见做法是对角错开布置,未证实为配方原文)。
effect.en: Horizontal position of blob B (at x% y%, vertical fixed at 30%). CodeFronts records only the first blob's position verbatim; 70% is a demo value (community practice offsets blobs diagonally, unverified as the literal recipe).

note.zh: 依赖多层 background + filter: blur/saturate(filter: Chrome 18 / Firefox 49 / Safari 6,BCD 调研 02§D1)+ oklch(Baseline 2023-05,调研 06§1);动画只动 transform,全浏览器可用。老浏览器退化路径见 fallback。
note.en: Relies on layered backgrounds plus filter: blur/saturate (filter: Chrome 18 / Firefox 49 / Safari 6 per BCD, research 02 §D1) and oklch (Baseline 2023-05, research 06 §1); the animation only transforms, safe everywhere. Legacy degradation in fallback.

fallback.zh: 不支持 filter 的环境直接显示未模糊的多光斑渐变(仍然成立,只是更『硬』);不支持 oklch 的极老环境可把光斑色换成同亮度的 srgb 等价色;reduced-motion 时整层静止。
fallback.en: Without filter support the unblurred multi-blob gradient still shows (just harder-edged); on very old engines without oklch swap blob colors for luminance-matched sRGB equivalents; under reduced-motion the layer stays static.

use.zh: 落地页/活动页的大面积氛围背景,上面承载文字卡片或玻璃面板
use.en: Hero/landing ambience under text cards or glass panels

use.zh: 毛玻璃的底衬——玻璃材质必须有丰富背景才成立,极光层是廉价的高质量底
use.en: Backdrop for glassmorphism — glass needs a rich backdrop, and aurora is a cheap high-quality one

use.zh: 暗色主题的产品营销图、空状态插画背景
use.en: Dark-theme marketing shots and empty-state illustration backgrounds

use.zh: 需要『活背景』但不想上 WebGL/视频的场景——只动 transform,合成器友好
use.en: Living backgrounds without WebGL/video — transform-only, compositor-friendly

avoid.zh: 正文阅读区背后——blur 层大面积重采样,滚动内容叠在上面时开销陡增
avoid.en: Behind body-text regions — a large blurred layer resamples expensively under scrolling content

avoid.zh: 光斑亮度超过 0.75 后直接压文字——配方心法是把光斑 L 钉在 0.6–0.75(CodeFronts)
avoid.en: Blob luminance past 0.75 crushes text contrast — the recipe's rule pins blob L at 0.6–0.75 (CodeFronts)

avoid.zh: 小尺寸控件内——42px 级模糊在小元素里只会得到一坨糊色
avoid.en: Inside small widgets — 42px-class blur turns into a muddy blob on small elements

avoid.zh: 需要精确品牌色的场景——blur+saturate 会改变渐变的呈现色,取色验收要对着最终渲染结果
avoid.en: Exact-brand-color contexts — blur+saturate shifts rendered colors; sample from the final composite

a11y.zh: 极光层是纯装饰:对屏幕阅读器不可达(aria-hidden / 空元素),不承载信息;其上文字按 WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3 核对 4.5:1(把光斑最亮处当作底色极端);prefers-reduced-motion 时必须停止漂移(demo 已实现静止降级)。
a11y.en: The aurora layer is pure decoration: invisible to screen readers (aria-hidden / empty elements), carrying no information; text on top must hold 4.5:1 per WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3 (treat the brightest blob as the worst-case backdrop); drift must stop under prefers-reduced-motion (the demo ships the static fallback).

goal.zh: 用纯 CSS 复刻一块可漂移的极光背景:4 个低亮度 oklch 光斑 + conic 底色,整层 inset 外扩、blur(42px) saturate(1.15),仅以 transform 缓慢漂移,上层放一张可读的文字卡。
goal.en: Replicate a drifting aurora background in pure CSS: four low-luminance oklch blobs over a conic base, the whole layer inset-oversized with blur(42px) saturate(1.15), drifting via transform only, with a readable text card on top.

acceptance.zh: 光斑用 radial-gradient(<尺寸> at x% y%, oklch(L 0.18–0.24 H / .55–.85), transparent ~68%),L 保持在 0.6–0.75
acceptance.en: Blobs use radial-gradient(<size> at x% y%, oklch(L 0.18–0.24 H / .55–.85), transparent ~68%) with L pinned at 0.6–0.75

acceptance.zh: 模糊与饱和只作用在整层容器(filter: blur(Npx) saturate(S)),不逐光斑设置
acceptance.en: Blur and saturate apply to the whole layer container (filter: blur(Npx) saturate(S)), not per blob

acceptance.zh: 整层 inset:-25% 外扩,动画只 transform(ease-in-out alternate infinite),避免边缘露底
acceptance.en: The layer is oversized with inset:-25% and animated via transform only (ease-in-out alternate infinite) so no edge gaps show

acceptance.zh: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时动画停止,背景静止但视觉完整
acceptance.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the animation stops and the background stays visually complete but static

acceptance.zh: 层为 aria-hidden 装饰,文字卡对比度在光斑最亮处仍达 4.5:1
acceptance.en: The layer is aria-hidden decoration; the text card keeps 4.5:1 over the brightest blob
